text.en: This Order may be cited as the Yayasan Sultan Haji Hassanal Bolkiah Act (Amendment of ScheduIe) Order, 2008 · Amendment of ScheduIe to Chapter 166 ·

Section 5 ) of the Schedule to the Yaya san Sultan Haji Hassanal Bolkiah Act is amended by deleting "section 12 " and by substituting "section 9 " therefor. Made this 19th. day of Syaaban , 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the 21st. day of August , 2008 at Our lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AN D YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM 2510
